checks.name: A saved room opens immersive by default
One floating top bar, 44 px high
No IDE menu/status bar, omo header, form rows, voice rows, station strip or footer
Top bar: room + people left, World/Tasks/Code centre, voice/share/⌘K right
No "Walk up and click this screen" banner in the DOM chrome
No raw project path visible
⌘K opens the command palette
Palette holds name/room code (share), recipes, agents, voice, speech, settings, customise
Typing filters the palette
Enter runs the command: Station recipes opens in the settings sheet
Settings → Share holds name + room code + Join
Settings → Voice holds the voice panel and Voice check
Settings → Agents holds the agents panel
Settings → Room holds Customise
Esc closes the sheet
Ctrl+K opens the palette while walking; Esc closes it
Tasks view shows under the bar
World returns to the room
Build mode: the World Builder opens below the top bar
Esc does not leave immersive
G leaves immersive and the choice is saved
G enters immersive again
no page errors
